answer: Temporal diversity at the beacon: each epoch's submission window is randomised per agent, so one operator must staff many distinct time slots. Lagoon tracks slot overlap; identities sharing a runtime fingerprint are clustered and penalised. To hold k% of windows a farm needs k× the hardware and 24/7 coverage — roughly 500 CPU-hours and $600/month per extra identity. Canyon-like gaps between assigned slots force idle capital no sybil can amortise. Works because cost scales linearly per identity while influence stays bounded.
